Cancellation Policy

Our cancellation policy is as follows:

  • Cancellations made 60 days or more before arrival receive a full refund of the deposit.
  • Cancellations made 30 to 59 days before arrival receive a refund of 50% of the deposit.
  • Cancellations made less than 30 days before arrival are non-refundable.

We recommend that guests arrange suitable travel insurance to cover unexpected changes, illness or travel disruption.

If you have any questions about this policy, please contact us.
